History row: 2026-09-26 03:15 PM | Bench Admin | checkout | fwsi19-n1 Bench Asset #BA-00004 - Bench Laptop Model | Bench Assignee | Checked out for bench run fwsi19-n1.

**Objective 7 — DONE.** Asset tag as displayed by the app: `BA-00004` (Snipe-IT assigned BA-00004, not BA-00012 as the example in the goal suggested).

No seed assets were modified, and no new models, locations, or users were created — all dropdown values were selected from existing options.
